findings.detail: calculated check needs 3 healthy children but has 2 - it can never report healthy
FAILOVER PRIMARY record www.example.com. A [www-primary] in zone example.com. carries no HealthCheckId, so Route 53 can never fail over to the secondary
HTTP health check for blog-old.example.com (198.51.100.14) is referenced by no record set, no calculated check and no CloudWatch alarm - it bills for nothing
health check for eu.example.com is used by 1 record set(s) but has no CloudWatch alarm in us-east-1 - a flip to unhealthy pages nobody
findings.remediation: aws cloudwatch put-metric-alarm --region us-east-1 --alarm-name r53-healthcheck-44444444-dddd-4ddd-9ddd-444444444444 --namespace AWS/Route53 --metric-name HealthCheckStatus --dimensions Name=HealthCheckId,Value=44444444-dddd-4ddd-9ddd-444444444444 --statistic Minimum --period 60 --evaluation-periods 2 --threshold 1 --comparison-operator LessThanThreshold --treat-missing-data breaching
